runs.content: YTD 2026 (all through Aug 7, independently compounded from Q1 x Q2 x Q3 -- ETFreplay's own YTD readout had arithmetic errors this run for QQQ, IWF, IVE, IWN): IWN +25.2%, IWD +23.3%, IWM +23.0%, QQQ +18.0%, SPY +14.0%, IVE +12.0%, IWF +5.5%. Growth vs value spread: IWD +23.3% vs IWF +5.5% -> value leads by 1780 bps, down from 2038 bps on Jul 31 -- the first narrowing of the year after five consecutive widenings. Notable: every ETF rallied in the first week of August, but growth gained more percentage points than value -- IWF's Q3 partial swung from -4.7% to +0.4% (largest single-week improvement of the year) while IWD's Q3 partial rose only from +3.9% to +6.2%. QQQ-IWF divergence ticked up slightly to 1248 bps (from 1209 bps Jul 31) as QQQ's rally (+12.3% -> +18.0% YTD) slightly outpaced IWF's. IWN remains top YTD performer; IWD edged ahead of IWM for second place.

runs.content: YTD 2026 (all through Jul 31): IWN +22.9%, IWD +20.6%, IWM +18.8%, QQQ +12.3%, IVE +10.1%, SPY +10.1%, IWF +0.2%. Growth vs value spread: IWD +20.6% vs IWF +0.2% -> value leads by 2038 bps, up from 1924 bps on Jul 24 -- a new YTD high. Notable: IWF's YTD return flipped back to positive (+0.2%) this week after briefly going negative on Jul 24, as its Q3 partial-quarter loss narrowed from -5.3% to -4.7%. QQQ also stabilized (Q3 -7.1% -> -6.6%, YTD +11.6% -> +12.3%). But value kept gaining faster than growth recovered -- IWD's Q3 gain extended to +3.9% -- so the value-over-growth spread widened despite growth's rebound. QQQ-IWF divergence held roughly flat at 1209 bps (from 1204 bps Jul 24) as both recovered in tandem. Small caps paused after their strong run: IWM essentially flat, IWN dipped marginally but retained the top YTD spot.
